set.body:
Owner: Alder build for portable dependency declarations; ScalaFIM owns adoption/consumer proof. ScalaFIM native HEAD887a5ce pins Alder aa998f88ac96c655aa6f4093ffb28492b9e31087, whose build uses unconditional file("../gale"), file("../resample4s") and file("../linop4s") ProjectRefs. In an isolated ScalaFIM checkout the normal build fails loading file:/private/tmp/plsneuro-surface-updates-27/gale even when only surfaceViewJavafxJVM/test is requested. Earlier in-place native tests had these sibling repositories available, so did not establish portability of the pinned closure.

Reproduction and workaround inputs: /private/tmp/plsneuro-surface-updates-27/native-test.log and alder-relative-build-inputs.json. Immutable sibling copies of clean Gale4485cc7, Resample6bc4172 and Linop4sfec77db restore the previous local closure; they are an explicit qualification workaround, not a provider repair. Separate current Intaglio override remains recorded. Acceptance: fix configurable/immutable dependency refs in native Alder, adopt its exact verified revision, and run ordinary isolated ScalaFIM loading plus affected module gates without undeclared sibling repositories. Do not broaden the surface-performance patch to hide this build issue.
set.title: Qualify the Alder dependency in an isolated ScalaFIM checkout
